description: Route protocol-callback calls to the synthesized dispatcher so multi-target collapses to single-target. Remove the resolve_function_call protocol_callback interception (jobs/semantic.rs:1161) so a protocol callback resolves as an ordinary function (one target = the dispatcher activation). Move any still-needed impl-module demand out of resolve_protocol_call into the dispatcher synthesis (depend on ProtocolDispatch(protocol); all built-in impls are co-located so they load with the protocol). ACCEPTANCE: /tmp/listrange.fz (Enum.take on a list AND a range) compiles with no 'multi-target direct callsite' error; concrete-receiver programs still monomorphize (one reachable arm). lib+matrix green. Depends on fz-bin.1.
title: Route protocol callback calls to the dispatcher (collapse multi-target)
